question: Should OpenClaw accept first-party Control UI math rendering through this MathJax approach, and under what dependency/vendor and delimiter rules?
rationale: The feature is useful, but accepting a default global typesetter, single-dollar parsing, and a same-origin vendored bundle changes product behavior and security review expectations that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Require tracked dependency and narrow syntax
options.body: Replace the opaque bundle with reviewed dependency/build provenance and keep default parsing to explicit math delimiters unless maintainers intentionally approve `$...$`.

options.title: Approve explicit vendoring
options.body: Accept a vendored MathJax asset only after documenting source, version, license, update path, and owner-approved review provenance.

options.title: Defer this branch
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of the canonical feature issue and a narrower markdown-stage implementation candidate.

recommendation.title: Require tracked dependency and narrow syntax
recommendation.body: Replace the opaque bundle with reviewed dependency/build provenance and keep default parsing to explicit math delimiters unless maintainers intentionally approve `$...$`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the original chat markdown renderer and adjacent Gateway/Control UI security surfaces, making him the best available owner for the product/security direction choice.
